_readme: The three acceptance documents (docs/DECISIONS.md 2026-09-22, plan Sec.4). `record.root` is `library` (resolved via tools.library.score_library.library_root(), which follows a worktree back to the main checkout) or `repo` (resolved against the git root). `record.md5` is a RECEIPT: null until tools.omr.acceptance runs once, after which it is written back here and every later run must match it or the command refuses loudly -- a shared record under library/_shared-records/ is machine-local and gitignored, so this receipt is the only way a later run (or a different machine) can tell whether the input under a committed id silently changed. `count_page.pdf_page_index` and `works_row_id` are the cleanup-count pages named in DECISIONS.md. `truth` is populated only for the engraved document, which has an exact page truth from Verovio; the two scans have no truth file and are scored only by the machine proxies plus Sean's periodic count.
